episode_summary: Gwen Snyder shares her journey in luxury real estate, emphasizing the power of building a referral-based business through authentic relationships and exceptional service. She discusses strategies for effective follow-up, the importance of pre-market preparations, and leveraging video marketing to stand out. Gwen's approach challenges conventional cold-calling methods, offering a refreshing perspective on client management and lead generation.
